summary: Seasoned IT Leader and Software Developer with over 25 years of comprehensive experience spanning full-stack development, software architecture, technical leadership, and enterprise systems. Track record of designing scalable applications, leading technical teams, automating complex IT workflows, and delivering high-performance solutions across diverse platforms.

experience.description: Direct the architecture, design, and full-lifecycle engineering of custom software solutions across desktop (Windows, Linux), mobile (Android), and web platforms. Partner with clients to translate business requirements into robust, high-performance applications.
highlights: Architect and ship full-stack web, mobile, and desktop applications utilizing C#, Java, Python, C++, and modern JavaScript.
Design and maintain custom database schemas and client websites using PHP, MySQL, and modern CMS platforms.
Implement continuous quality assurance, clean architecture principles, and secure deployment pipelines.

experience.description: Serve as Subject Matter Expert providing high-tier engineering and support for 5,000+ local and remote enterprise users. Spearhead internal IT automation initiatives.
highlights: Develop and maintain enterprise automation scripts and internal utilities in PowerShell and Python to streamline support operations.
Resolve complex hardware, software, security, and network issues across Windows, macOS, and enterprise mobile environments.
Champion IT security compliance, author comprehensive engineering documentation, and mentor junior technical analysts.

experience.description: Led and mentored a high-performing team of desktop technicians delivering mission-critical computing hardware and software support.
highlights: Managed operational schedules, performance reviews, resource allocations, and SLA adherence across multi-site regional teams.
Collaborated with executive leadership on regional IT strategy and technology modernization roadmaps.
Fostered continuous learning programs in emerging technologies and software best practices.

experience.description: Delivered comprehensive enterprise hardware, software, and systems infrastructure support for 2,000+ local and distributed employees.
highlights: Supported enterprise software architectures including Siebel CRM, IBM OS/390, IBM AS/400, Windows Server, and Avaya telecom platforms.
Drove root-cause analysis on critical production incidents, minimizing downtime and business interruption.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
education.highlights: Advanced coursework in software engineering, object-oriented design, data structures, and database systems.
Foundational computing studies and early software development interest.
